skills.name: Hurlthorn
skills.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Moze's ATK to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: Fleetwinged Raid
skills.desc:
Marks a designated single enemy target as "Prey" and deals to it Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Moze's ATK, and gains #2[i] points of Charge.
When there are no other characters on the field that are capable of combat, Moze cannot use his Skill and dispels the enemy's "Prey" state.

skills.name: Dash In, Gash Out
skills.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Moze's ATK to one designated enemy target, and launches the Talent's Follow-Up ATK against this target. If the target is defeated before this Follow-Up ATK is used, then launches the Follow-Up ATK against a random single enemy instead.

skills.name: Cascading Featherblade
skills.desc:
When "Prey" exists on the field, Moze will enter the Departed state.
After ally targets attack "Prey," Moze will additionally deal 1 instance of Lightning Additional DMG equal to #1[i]% of his ATK and consumes 1 point of Charge. For every #2[i] point(s) of Charge consumed, Moze launches 1 Follow-Up ATK to "Prey," dealing Lightning DMG equal to #3[i]% of his ATK. When Charge reaches 0, dispels the target's "Prey" state and resets the tally of Charge points required to launch Follow-Up ATK. Talent's Follow-Up ATK does not consume Charge.

skills.name: Bated Wings
skills.desc: After using Technique, enters the Stealth state for #1[i] second(s). While in Stealth, Moze is undetectable by enemies. If Moze attacks enemies to enter combat while in Stealth, increases DMG by #2[i]%, lasting for #3[i] turn(s).

passives.name: Nightfeather
passives.desc: After using Talent's Follow-Up ATK, recovers 1 Skill Point(s). This effect can trigger again after 1 turn(s).

passives.name: Daggerhold
passives.desc: When Moze dispels his Departed state, his action advances by 20%. At the start of each wave, Moze's action advances by 30%.

passives.name: Vengewise
passives.desc: When dealing DMG by using Ultimate, it is considered as having launched a Follow-Up ATK. The Follow-Up ATK DMG taken by the "Prey" increases by 25%.
